data.desc: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. a member of the Holcim Group, is a cement company, located in the Northern region of Peru. In February 2012, the Company's shares were listed on The New York Stock Exchange - Euronext under the ticker symbol 'CPAC'. With almost 70 years of operating history, the Company produces, distributes and sells cement and cement-related materials, such as ready-mix concrete and precast materials. Pacasmayo's products are primarily used in construction, which has been one of the fastest-growing segments of the Peruvian economy in recent years. The Company also produces and sells quicklime for use in mining operations.
